name: background-computer-use
description: Observe occluded Windows apps and operate background controls without global mouse input, with optional guarded restoration of the previous foreground window and desktop.

interface.shortDescription: View covered windows and work without taking over the host mouse.
interface.longDescription: Strict capture of covered Windows apps with identity-bound UI Automation controls, verified child surfaces and window-message clicks. Optional guarded handback returns to the saved foreground window and desktop after app-triggered activation, including while keyboard activity continues when the pointer and action window remain unchanged.
